h1: Custom SJ Lanyards for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom SJ lanyards in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for events, security, and ID badges. Fast turnaround.
introHtml: Custom SJ lanyards offer a versatile and durable option for organizations needing reliable badge holders. Whether you need breakaway safety features for a school or antimicrobial materials for a healthcare facility, the SJ supplier line provides options like the 1" Knit-In Lanyard for heavy-duty use or the 3/8" Knit-In Lanyard for a lighter feel. Decorate with full-color imprinting to reinforce your brand at trade shows or daily operations.
heroAltText: Bulk custom SJ lanyards with printed logos and safety breakaway feature for ID badges
